en.text: The words of King Lemuel—the revelation which his mother taught him:

zhSimplified.text: 利慕伊勒王的言语，是他母亲教训他的真言。

zhTraditional.text: 利慕伊勒王的言語，是他母親教訓他的真言。

en.text: “Oh, my son! Oh, son of my womb! Oh, son of my vows!

zhSimplified.text: 我的儿啊，我腹中生的儿啊， 我许愿得的儿啊！我当怎样教训你呢？

zhTraditional.text: 我的兒啊，我腹中生的兒啊， 我許願得的兒啊！我當怎樣教訓你呢？

en.text: Don’t give your strength to women, nor your ways to that which destroys kings.

zhSimplified.text: 不要将你的精力给妇女； 也不要有败坏君王的行为。

zhTraditional.text: 不要將你的精力給婦女； 也不要有敗壞君王的行為。

en.text: It is not for kings, Lemuel, it is not for kings to drink wine, nor for princes to say, ‘Where is strong drink?’

zhSimplified.text: 利慕伊勒啊，君王喝酒，君王喝酒不相宜； 王子说浓酒在那里也不相宜；

zhTraditional.text: 利慕伊勒啊，君王喝酒，君王喝酒不相宜； 王子說濃酒在那裏也不相宜；

en.text: lest they drink, and forget the law, and pervert the justice due to anyone who is afflicted.

zhSimplified.text: 恐怕喝了就忘记律例， 颠倒一切困苦人的是非。

zhTraditional.text: 恐怕喝了就忘記律例， 顛倒一切困苦人的是非。

en.text: Give strong drink to him who is ready to perish, and wine to the bitter in soul.

zhSimplified.text: 可以把浓酒给将亡的人喝， 把清酒给苦心的人喝，

zhTraditional.text: 可以把濃酒給將亡的人喝， 把清酒給苦心的人喝，

en.text: Let him drink, and forget his poverty, and remember his misery no more.

zhSimplified.text: 让他喝了，就忘记他的贫穷， 不再记念他的苦楚。

zhTraditional.text: 讓他喝了，就忘記他的貧窮， 不再記念他的苦楚。

en.text: Open your mouth for the mute, in the cause of all who are left desolate.

zhSimplified.text: 你当为哑巴开口， 为一切孤独的伸冤。

zhTraditional.text: 你當為啞巴開口， 為一切孤獨的伸冤。

en.text: Open your mouth, judge righteously, and serve justice to the poor and needy.”

zhSimplified.text: 你当开口按公义判断， 为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

zhTraditional.text: 你當開口按公義判斷， 為困苦和窮乏的辨屈。

en.text: Who can find a worthy woman? For her value is far above rubies.

footnotes.text: 31:10 Proverbs 31:10-31 form an acrostic, with each verse starting with each letter of the Hebrew alphabet, in order.

zhSimplified.text: 才德的妇人谁能得着呢？ 她的价值远胜过珍珠。

zhTraditional.text: 才德的婦人誰能得着呢？ 她的價值遠勝過珍珠。

en.text: The heart of her husband trusts in her. He shall have no lack of gain.

zhSimplified.text: 她丈夫心里倚靠她， 必不缺少利益；

zhTraditional.text: 她丈夫心裏倚靠她， 必不缺少利益；

en.text: She does him good, and not harm, all the days of her life.

zhSimplified.text: 她一生使丈夫有益无损。

zhTraditional.text: 她一生使丈夫有益無損。

en.text: She seeks wool and flax, and works eagerly with her hands.

zhSimplified.text: 她寻找羊绒和麻， 甘心用手做工。

zhTraditional.text: 她尋找羊羢和麻， 甘心用手做工。

en.text: She is like the merchant ships. She brings her bread from afar.

zhSimplified.text: 她好像商船从远方运粮来，

zhTraditional.text: 她好像商船從遠方運糧來，

en.text: She rises also while it is yet night, gives food to her household, and portions for her servant girls.

zhSimplified.text: 未到黎明她就起来， 把食物分给家中的人， 将当做的工分派婢女。

zhTraditional.text: 未到黎明她就起來， 把食物分給家中的人， 將當做的工分派婢女。

en.text: She considers a field, and buys it. With the fruit of her hands, she plants a vineyard.

zhSimplified.text: 她想得田地就买来； 用手所得之利栽种葡萄园。

zhTraditional.text: 她想得田地就買來； 用手所得之利栽種葡萄園。

en.text: She arms her waist with strength, and makes her arms strong.

zhSimplified.text: 她以能力束腰， 使膀臂有力。

zhTraditional.text: 她以能力束腰， 使膀臂有力。

en.text: She perceives that her merchandise is profitable. Her lamp doesn’t go out by night.

zhSimplified.text: 她觉得所经营的有利； 她的灯终夜不灭。

zhTraditional.text: 她覺得所經營的有利； 她的燈終夜不滅。

en.text: She lays her hands to the distaff, and her hands hold the spindle.

zhSimplified.text: 她手拿捻线竿， 手把纺线车。

zhTraditional.text: 她手拿撚線竿， 手把紡線車。

en.text: She opens her arms to the poor; yes, she extends her hands to the needy.

zhSimplified.text: 她张手周济困苦人， 伸手帮补穷乏人。

zhTraditional.text: 她張手賙濟困苦人， 伸手幫補窮乏人。

en.text: She is not afraid of the snow for her household, for all her household are clothed with scarlet.

zhSimplified.text: 她不因下雪为家里的人担心， 因为全家都穿着朱红衣服。

zhTraditional.text: 她不因下雪為家裏的人擔心， 因為全家都穿着朱紅衣服。

en.text: She makes for herself carpets of tapestry. Her clothing is fine linen and purple.

zhSimplified.text: 她为自己制作绣花毯子； 她的衣服是细麻和紫色布做的。

zhTraditional.text: 她為自己製作繡花毯子； 她的衣服是細麻和紫色布做的。

en.text: Her husband is respected in the gates, when he sits among the elders of the land.

zhSimplified.text: 她丈夫在城门口与本地的长老同坐， 为众人所认识。

zhTraditional.text: 她丈夫在城門口與本地的長老同坐， 為眾人所認識。

en.text: She makes linen garments and sells them, and delivers sashes to the merchant.

zhSimplified.text: 她做细麻布衣裳出卖， 又将腰带卖与商家。

zhTraditional.text: 她做細麻布衣裳出賣， 又將腰帶賣與商家。

en.text: Strength and dignity are her clothing. She laughs at the time to come.

zhSimplified.text: 能力和威仪是她的衣服； 她想到日后的景况就喜笑。

zhTraditional.text: 能力和威儀是她的衣服； 她想到日後的景況就喜笑。

en.text: She opens her mouth with wisdom. Kind instruction is on her tongue.

zhSimplified.text: 她开口就发智慧； 她舌上有仁慈的法则。

zhTraditional.text: 她開口就發智慧； 她舌上有仁慈的法則。

en.text: She looks well to the ways of her household, and doesn’t eat the bread of idleness.

zhSimplified.text: 她观察家务， 并不吃闲饭。

zhTraditional.text: 她觀察家務， 並不吃閒飯。

en.text: Her children rise up and call her blessed. Her husband also praises her:

zhSimplified.text: 她的儿女起来称她有福； 她的丈夫也称赞她，

zhTraditional.text: 她的兒女起來稱她有福； 她的丈夫也稱讚她，

en.text: “Many women do noble things, but you excel them all.”

zhSimplified.text: 说：才德的女子很多， 惟独你超过一切。

zhTraditional.text: 說：才德的女子很多， 惟獨你超過一切。

en.text: Charm is deceitful, and beauty is vain; but a woman who fears the LORD, she shall be praised.

zhSimplified.text: 艳丽是虚假的，美容是虚浮的； 惟敬畏耶和华的妇女必得称赞。

zhTraditional.text: 艷麗是虛假的，美容是虛浮的； 惟敬畏耶和華的婦女必得稱讚。

en.text: Give her of the fruit of her hands! Let her works praise her in the gates!

zhSimplified.text: 愿她享受操作所得的； 愿她的工作在城门口荣耀她。

zhTraditional.text: 願她享受操作所得的； 願她的工作在城門口榮耀她。
